summary: Accepted as bounded callable/synthetic capability evidence and width-only repair failure on IMG_5641. Actual course rail geometry, endpoint arrival and generalized organic-blob rejection remain unknown.

findings.claim: Nominal 30 px stripe width estimate 29 px
findings.assessment: Confirmed; fixture strict inequality fills 29 rows, so this is rasterization bookkeeping, not 1 px estimator error.

Confirmed for these uniform binary fixtures. Centered expected W = 30 returns 1, offset 4 px returns 0; broad 60/90 px returns 0. Supplemental offset 2 px already returns 0 despite valid paired edges; fixed-center score does not establish ribbon absence.

Confirmed and strengthened. Nominal 59/60 px each fill 59 rows; returned 57 px with 4.5 lum/px weak pair versus 36 lum/px away from the boundary. Nominal 61/62 px each fill 61 rows and return null. Fixed lateral profile extent and end suppression constrain this operation.
Confirmed default 3 px center gate. At 3.25 px offset default returns null; latLim = 12 recovers 29 px width, 36 lum/px,center −3.25 px. No production setting changed.
Confirmed original pure probe: uniform support/theta field preserves y = 80/y = 84 over 45 px; zero bends. No actual ribbon centering was tested in that uniform field.

Confirmed independently by W2 fresh native replay: entire native baseline receipt matches historical receipt; all 5 widths retain identical fields, traces, and variant hashes. Single 50/55 px banks reach 37 px but no basket; expanded bank remains 27.75 px. Additional reach is not repair.

headingFreshObservation.limitation: Heading substitution also fails endpoint arrival; cannot attribute later progress to width calibration.

limits: No held-out course geometry was measured.
No claim that any returned edge pair is true physical ribbon evidence.
No production changes, Git changes, AA changes, sealed corpus access, or duplicate full replay.
nextGate: Real visible straight-segment profiles plus independent held-out widths and center residuals are required before promoting a calibrated width bank.
